metric: seeded agent configs byte-identical after magpie uninstall (sandboxed, throwaway HOME)
reason: LiteLLM already gives every agent one OpenAI-compatible endpoint; magpie's extra is rewriting each agent's own config, which is the runtime takeover. Uninstall leaves residue in every config it touched, so it is not cleanly removable.

pgrep -f for running codex, gemini and the ChatGPT desktop app
systemctl --user is-system-running; daemon install writes a systemd user unit (failed here: no user bus)
